<div class="card-body">
'''Frozen Dinner''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] ([[Immediate Effect]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">冷凍ディナー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ワンパの雪洞に単独でいる任意のキャラクターに配備する。キャラクターは戦闘力＝０、移動不可となる。その場所に敵のライトセーバーか合計能力値＞４があるとキャンセルされる。キャラクターが生物に食べられたなら、凶暴性に２を加える（累積可能）。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Frozen-Dinner-PSA-147361096.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">フリーズ・ドライですぐに食べられ、味も抜群！ 反乱軍の野郎ども全員を食糧にすれば、ワンパー族全体をまかなえる。人間はガウゥゥゥ、ウ、マ、イ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Frozen dinner.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on any character alone at the Wampa Cave. The character is power = 0 and may not move. Canceled if an opponent's lightsaber or total ability > 4 is at that location. If the character is eaten by a creature, add 2 to ferocity (cumulative).

'''Lore:'''
Freeze-dried and ready to eat, outstanding flavor! Feed the whole wampa clan on Rebel scum. Humans are gr-r-reat.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Frozen Dinner]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
